deviations.requirement: Overload protection of the string DC cable (coordination I_B <= I_n <= I_z and I_2 <= 1.45 I_z per 433.1) is not provided; the partial-range aBat string fuse gives short-circuit protection only.
deviations.reason: The string cable cannot carry overload current. The BMS and PCS limit the string current to at most about 96 A, and the cable is rated I_z of about 162 A after ambient and grouping derating. The cable is protected against short circuit by the aBat fuse per clause 434. The cable is a single point-to-point circuit from rack to PCS input with no branches or socket-outlets. Overcurrents below the fuse's breaking range are interrupted by the string contactor and BMS.
